summary: Phase 1b regression: min_order_usd persistence through Settings → Payments UI verified end-to-end via Playwright on the preview URL using the throwaway QA account. All 4 required steps + optional clear/blank step PASSED. The previously reported 'reverts to old value after Save + reload' bug is CLOSED.
seed_data_creation: None. Only mutated min_order_usd on the throwaway QA brand: 25 -> 50 -> blank across the test run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Payment tolerance accordion is collapsed by default; the min_order_usd input is present in DOM but hidden until the accordion header is clicked. When reading its value with Playwright, use input_value / DOM .value directly (element.is_visible() returns false while collapsed). data-testid attributes used: settings-min-order-input, settings-save-changes-btn, settings-rail-payments, login-email-input, password-input, signin-submit-btn. Field also has name=min_order_usd. Save toast: 'Brand updated successfully!'.

test_evidence.step2_initial_load_value: 25.00 (expected 25/25.00) - PASS - proves initialValues maps min_order_usd on load
test_evidence.step3_after_save_value: 50.00 (expected 50) - PASS - form remounted with fresh company data, save toast 'Brand updated successfully!' displayed
test_evidence.step4_after_full_reload_value: 50.00 (expected 50) - PASS - value persists through browser reload, no revert to 25 or blank. CORE REGRESSION CLOSED.
test_evidence.bonus_clear_save_reload_value: '' blank (expected blank) - PASS - clearing the field and saving persists as blank (inherits platform default), no error

rca of the issue: N/A - bug already fixed by main agent before this iteration. This run only re-verified UI persistence. Fix was: CompanySettingsDialog initialValues useMemo maps companyAny.min_order_usd (L163-214); PAYMENT_FIELDS includes min_order_usd in handleSubmit scopedValues (L408); handleClose remounts form and onClose refetches companies -- all working as designed.
